regression_evidence: Three regressions reproduced before changes: Senate reordered the source row, disclosure had no intermediate positions, and dropped connectors had diagonal segments. All three checks pass with stable model order, anchored transitions and libavoid routing.
checks: Stable order through opening and closing all five source branches; Senate fourth
Intermediate animation frames, fixed screen anchor and unchanged zoom
Orthogonal rerouting on dragfree with other node positions and camera unchanged
Reduced motion keeps the screen anchor
New request cancels an active transition
Main-stage order and Senate return placement
ILP signers beside their signature stage
Visible ELK and libavoid failures, no automatic retry or alternative engine
Reading cards and terms preserves graph and viewport
Fullscreen enter/exit, mobile bounds, no page scroll
No HTTP requests during page use; embedded WASM
cleanup: ELK node placement and libavoid routing have separate responsibilities
Relative Cytoscape stretching is no longer the final result after a drop
ELK bend-point rendering removed; all final paths come from libavoid
Disclosure no longer automatically fits or zooms the viewport
limits: Crossing minimization is heuristic; zero edge crossings is not guaranteed
Manual placement on top of another card is not resolved by moving other nodes
Edges are hidden during the 320 ms card transition and rebuilt at its end
